eps.t: The Defeated Warrior Princess, Taken Captive
eps.ov: Serafina, a knight from the Illdoren Kingdom fighting in an eastern expedition, meets her match.
Veor shows Serafina a small part of his life, leading to no small bit of culture shock.

eps.t: To Be a Warrior is To Be a Hypocrite
eps.ov: Veor intends on introducing Sera to more of the tribe, but the cultural exchange is suddenly interrupted.

eps.t: A Drinking Party Clears the Fog
eps.ov: Sera is introduced to the chiefs of the other tribes, who are not what she expected.

eps.t: Hands that Pray For Coming Conflict
eps.ov: A party headed by a retinue priest from the eastern expedition shows up, looking to "rescue" Sera.
Sera works with Veor and the barbarians to overcome the Fiend, before having an unexpected reunion.
Sera and Malcius witness the ritual to undo the damage caused by the Fiend.

eps.t: A Contract in the Form of a Collaring
eps.ov: After her engagement necklace comes off, Sera tries to find a way to put back on.

eps.t: Visions Upon the Scales of the Soul
eps.ov: With Sera feeling conflicted, Veor offers a suggestion to help her gain perspective.
Sera and her group arrive at the Quefto city of Furnace Ridge.

eps.t: Discovery is the Mother of All Quefto
eps.ov: Sera learns the incredible inspiration behind the Quefto's curiosity.
Sera and Veor, with a cohort of Quefto, do battle against the fearsome Guren Nairi!
